notes.title: Version 1.12 - improved Controller settings and Menu Navigation
notes.notes:
Improved controls  - Xbox controller and buttons assigned are displayed on main menu screen. 

Added a Boost Button  - when held down the rebounder speed will increase to help catch the ball in time.

Menu navigation - now works with Keyboard, Controller or Mouse, useful for handheld PCs or if gaming with a controller

Controller Input - No need to change input type in settings so can now switch between using Controller, Keyboard or Mouse during play.

Bug fix - level 6 border lights were not working in time to the music - now resolved[

notes.title: V1.11 - minor bug fix - music volume on splash screen
notes.notes:
When starting the game the splash screen was not using music volume settings set in the settings menu.
This has now been resolved.

notes.title: Version 1.10 - More Levels and Settings
notes.notes:
Added Stage 6 which includes an additional 10 Levels, bug fixes the ability to now change the intensity of the Lasers, Strobe and Floor lights & a Mystery Random Powerup drop.

Stage 6 with 10 new levels 
10 new fun and challenging levels to complete and get your name on the high score tables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213527/85d8106e2ac919bc1e98b83c2e4960693b1b6846.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213527/393c1b88537c89325e2bebb51c281e82a8354271.gif

Lights and Laser intensity can now be modified
In the main menu settings you can modify the light settings from 0 for no lights to 15 for maximum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213527/4d213fff5b2d9135b3e0eacb2440a4b8b203aa73.png

If your playing the game and want to tweak the lighting you can do. Simply press the Esc key and modify the lights as you go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213527/3b9c11502a975d3f31857573f74ef9b1264049ab.png

Mystery Powerup
The Mystery Powerup when collected will randomly assign a powerup. So take a chance and see what you get.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213527/36ac1d688e8aabe649867cbcfc300776de250cb2.png

Other changes include:
- Ball speed will now go back to the normal speed after the speed ball or slow mo powerup has finished.
- Bonus Points FX are more visible and other minor tweaks
